prompt:
A young adult East Asian woman sitting in a minimalist white interior space, medium close-up to half-body composition, centered slightly left. Body leaning slightly forward, shoulders naturally inward, arms forward, pose is quiet, relaxed, and slightly fragile. Head slightly tilted, facing the camera, gaze is calm, soft, and slightly detached, lips naturally parted, no obvious smile.

Exquisite soft oval face, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, slender bridge of the nose, light nude pink lips. Very light makeup, only natural eyelashes, slight eyeliner, and soft blush. Fair warm skin tone, retaining real pores, fine peach fuzz, natural skin variations, soft highlights, and light shadows, no plastic smoothing.

Deep dark brown long hair, naturally loose, voluminous with slight messy waves. Fluffy but real hair strands, with some wisps falling on forehead, eyes, cheeks, neck, and chest, creating a casual, unstyled home texture.

She wears a thin white loose shirt, buttons partially undone, fabric soft and slightly wrinkled with a light semi-transparent gauzy feel; collar and one shoulder naturally sliding off, revealing neck, collarbone, and a white spaghetti strap camisole underneath. Overall clothing is fresh, clean, and subtle, not overexposed.

Background is a minimalist white or light gray wall, no clutter, quiet and clean space. Light is soft natural window light or high-key studio diffused light, coming from the front left, very shallow shadows, overall low saturation and low contrast, dominated by cream white, light gray, and natural skin tones. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, eyes and face in focus, soft background blur, slight film grain, real photographic texture, Japanese soft lifestyle portrait, photorealistic.

Avoid: Cartoon, CG, illustration, over-smoothing, heavy makeup, exaggerated expressions, exaggerated body, wrong fingers, deformed arms, messy background, strong HDR, over-sharpening, text, watermarks, logos.

promptZh:
一位年轻的东亚女性 坐在 简约的白色室内空间 中，中景至半身构图，居中偏左。身体微微前倾，双肩自然内收，双臂向前，姿态安静、放松且带有一丝脆弱感。头部微倾，面向镜头，目光平静、柔和且略显疏离，双唇自然微张，没有明显的笑容。

精致的柔和鹅蛋脸，杏仁状深棕色眼眸，自然的细眉，鼻梁挺拔，浅裸粉色双唇。妆容极淡，仅有自然睫毛、淡淡的眼线和柔和的腮红。白皙温暖的肤色，保留真实的毛孔、细微的绒毛、自然的皮肤纹理、柔和的高光和淡淡的阴影，无塑料感磨皮。

深棕色长发，自然披散，发量蓬松且带有轻微凌乱的波浪感。发丝蓬松真实，几缕碎发散落在额头、眼睛、脸颊、颈部和胸前，营造出随意、未经刻意打理的居家质感。

她穿着 一件白色薄款宽松衬衫，纽扣部分解开，面料柔软且带有轻微褶皱，呈现出轻薄的半透明纱质感；领口和一侧肩膀自然滑落，露出颈部、锁骨以及内搭的白色细肩带吊带衫。整体着装清新、干净且含蓄，不过分暴露。

背景为简约的白色或浅灰色墙面，无杂物，空间安静整洁。光线为柔和的自然窗光或高调摄影棚漫射光，从左前方射入，阴影极浅，整体低饱和度、低对比度，以奶油白、浅灰和自然肤色为主。摄影风格：85mm 肖像镜头，f/1.8 大光圈，浅景深，焦点对准眼睛和面部，背景柔焦，带有轻微胶片颗粒感，真实的摄影质感，日系柔和生活肖像，照片级写实。

避免：卡通、CG、插画、过度磨皮、浓妆、夸张表情、夸张身材、手指错误、手臂变形、杂乱背景、强 HDR、过度锐化、文字、水印、Logo。
